pictures.name: LG1-Old-Market
pictures.prompt: An old Arabian market lane at dusk, long ago: a merchant’s stall under a striped awning with brass scales, bolts of cloth, sacks of grain and a closed leather ledger, oil lamps lit, the lane empty and quiet. Warm and rich. No people or human figures of any kind. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
